methodology.red: Verified U18 athlete is confirmed in an active draw/player field or order of play.
methodology.amber: Pre-draw acceptance pool, incomplete/partial active field, U18 pre-draw watch, or targeted U18 candidate.
methodology.green: Credible active draw/player field captured with no verified U18 exposure or targeted U18 candidate.
methodology.important: Unknown DOB alone does not create manual review. Only a specific U18/junior-age indicator creates a targeted age exception.
methodology.scope: Main draw, qualifying, doubles, wild cards, acceptance lists, accepted alternates and order of play are in scope.
methodology.screening: Tournament entrants are cross-matched against a dynamic verified-U18 registry and an ITF junior-age candidate universe.
